text: On the authority of Omar Ibn Al-Khattab - may God be pleased with him - he said: The Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: There is not one of you who performs ablution and completes it and then says: I bear witness that there is no god but God, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger, except that the eight gates of Paradise are opened for him, and he enters through whichever one he wishes.
